tests.title: parses named and positional options with native defaults, names and ranges, and refuses everything else with exact messages
truncates delays as config_input does, reduces them modulo native's power-of-two ring and derives balance coefficients
pins dbl for every input format, refuses non-stereo layouts and plans an unchanged count with an exact ring reservation
matches a transcription of the C loop for every option family, independent of frame splits, without touching its input
refuses non-stereo frames, rate changes, oversized rings and frames, emits nothing for empty input and observes cancellation
matches native PCM bytes for every option sweep at 8000/44100/48000 Hz, stereo from every source format into f64/f32/s16
matches native framecrc across frame splits, WAV input, output selection and frame limits, and at rates where native wraps its power-of-two ring
refuses mono, three-channel, out-of-range and unimplemented forms before output, beside native status

details.compares: raw PCM bytes (f64le, plus f32le/s16le for defaults and the positional form, and for all sweeps on f64 input), -cpuflags 0: 21 option sweeps x 8000/44100/48000 Hz x stereo u8/s16/s32/f32/f64 raw input
framecrc (pcm_f64le, -bitexact): raw and WAV s16/f64 input, 5 chains (asetnsamples splits before/after, haas in series, volume/aformat neighbours) x 6 input/output -ss/-t/-frames:a profiles
raw f64 PCM bytes at 1/100/6400/12800/25600/192000 Hz with 40 ms and near-40 ms delays (native ring wrap)
native exit status per refusal (0, 8, 222, 234) beside ours: non-zero exit, nothing written, exact message

unsupported: FLAC input (refused before decoding: FLAC input to haas requires additional Native evidence)
expressions, SI suffixes and other non-literal numeric values (native accepts)
runtime commands (haas has no process_command; the chain has none)
mono, 3+ channel and non-default-mask stereo input (native remixes implicitly)
automatic sample-rate conversion next to haas
float output on platforms other than linux/x64

proposedContracts.name: parses named and positional options with native defaults, names and ranges, and refuses everything else with exact messages
proposedContracts.scope: option syntax, native defaults/ranges and exact refusal messages

proposedContracts.name: truncates delays as config_input does, reduces them modulo native's power-of-two ring and derives balance coefficients
proposedContracts.scope: delay truncation, ring modulo reduction and balance coefficients

proposedContracts.name: pins dbl for every input format, refuses non-stereo layouts and plans an unchanged count with an exact ring reservation
proposedContracts.scope: dbl negotiation, stereo constraint, counts, packet sections and reservations

proposedContracts.name: matches a transcription of the C loop for every option family, independent of frame splits, without touching its input
proposedContracts.scope: output against a C-loop transcription under frame splits, ownership

proposedContracts.name: refuses non-stereo frames, rate changes, oversized rings and frames, emits nothing for empty input and observes cancellation
proposedContracts.scope: stream refusals, allocation limits, empty input and cancellation

proposedContracts.name: matches native PCM bytes for every option sweep at 8000/44100/48000 Hz, stereo from every source format into f64/f32/s16
proposedContracts.scope: raw PCM bytes vs native across option sweeps, rates, sources and outputs (linux/x64)

proposedContracts.name: matches native framecrc across frame splits, WAV input, output selection and frame limits, and at rates where native wraps its power-of-two ring
proposedContracts.scope: framecrc vs native across frame splits, WAV, time selection, frame limits and ring-wrap rates (linux/x64)

proposedContracts.name: refuses mono, three-channel, out-of-range and unimplemented forms before output, beside native status
proposedContracts.scope: explicit refusals before output beside native exit status

notes: Native's power-of-two ring is replaced by a max(delay)+1 ring with each delay reduced modulo native's ring size; this reproduces native at rates where sample_rate*40ms is a power of two (verified at 6400/12800/25600 Hz).
Positional option values follow libavfilter shorthand in AVOption order; verified for one 13-value form against native.
No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
Setup durations: submodule 35s, npm ci 7s, reference:build 138s, baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 52s, baseline unit 67s.
